_comment: Every upstream source the app's data comes from. `probe` is what the weekly probe does with it: 'change+stale' (report a new upstream version and a stale one), 'stale' (only report age; something else already refreshes it) or 'none' (not probed; recorded here for its licence and its fetch script). A new source is not accepted without a licence and an attribution (tests/test_probe_sources.py).

sources.name: BIS locational banking statistics
sources.licence: BIS terms of permitted use; only a small derived network is redistributed
sources.attribution: Bank for International Settlements, Locational Banking Statistics

sources.name: IMF CPIS (via the DBnomics mirror)
sources.licence: IMF Special Terms for Statistical Data (https://www.imf.org/en/about/copyright-and-terms, read 2026-10-26): data may be downloaded, copied, used to make derivative works and distributed with attribution to the IMF as the source and no alteration that affects its nature or accuracy; commercial reuse needs permission from copyright@imf.org; bulk download by automated technology needs explicit permission. Retrieved today through DBnomics' mirror of the IMF SDMX API.
sources.attribution: International Monetary Fund, Coordinated Portfolio Investment Survey

sources.name: OECD market series, retrieved through FRED
sources.cadence: daily upstream; the app uses year-end values and rebuilds by hand
sources.licence: The three series used (IRLTLT01, IRSTCI01, SPASTT01) are OECD data that FRED labels 'Copyrighted: Citation Required' (checked on the US series, 2026-10-26). The OECD's own terms allow copying, adapting and redistributing data, commercially too, with credit to the OECD (https://www.oecd.org/en/about/terms-conditions.html, last updated 2024-07-01), unless a dataset has third-party restrictions. UNRESOLVED: FRED's own terms (https://fred.stlouisfed.org/legal/) prohibit storing FRED content in a database or archive, which retrieving through FRED and committing market_data.json arguably does. See docs/plans/2026-09-23-automated-data-refresh.md.
sources.attribution: OECD (2026), Main Economic Indicators, via FRED, Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis, https://fred.stlouisfed.org/ (retrieved 2026-07-30, the date market_data.json was last built)
